queries.sql: SELECT DISTINCT dataset_id,policy_version,area_mapping_sha256,product_master_sha256,publication_status,product_reference_sha256,transaction_evidence_sha256,catalog_helper_sha256 FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19

SELECT COUNT(*) AS differences FROM workspace.medshield_silver.sales_restart_clean_candidate VERSION AS OF 10 s
      FULL OUTER JOIN workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19 f ON s.source_record_id=f.source_record_id
      WHERE s.source_record_id IS NULL OR f.source_record_id IS NULL OR NOT(s.`dataset_id` <=> f.`dataset_id`) OR NOT(s.`source_record_id` <=> f.`source_record_id`) OR NOT(s.`source_workbook` <=> f.`source_workbook`) OR NOT(s.`source_file_sha256` <=> f.`source_file_sha256`) OR NOT(s.`source_path` <=> f.`source_path`) OR NOT(s.`raw_csv_line` <=> f.`raw_csv_line`) OR NOT(s.`source_layout` <=> f.`source_layout`) OR NOT(s.`area_raw` <=> f.`area_raw`) OR NOT(s.`product_raw` <=> f.`product_raw`) OR NOT(s.`dr_number_raw` <=> f.`dr_number_raw`) OR NOT(s.`date_delivered_raw` <=> f.`date_delivered_raw`) OR NOT(s.`area` <=> f.`area`) OR NOT(s.`product` <=> f.`product`) OR NOT(s.`dr_number` <=> f.`dr_number`) OR NOT(s.`net_value_source` <=> f.`net_value_source`) OR NOT(s.`record_kind` <=> f.`record_kind`) OR NOT(s.`disposition` <=> f.`disposition`) OR NOT(s.`business_fingerprint` <=> f.`business_fingerprint`) OR NOT(s.`snapshot_reference_source_record_id` <=> f.`snapshot_reference_source_record_id`) OR NOT(s.`silver_version` <=> f.`silver_version`) OR NOT(s.`reporting_year_basis` <=> f.`reporting_year_basis`) OR NOT(s.`quantity_raw` <=> f.`quantity_raw`) OR NOT(s.`unit_selling_price_raw` <=> f.`unit_selling_price_raw`) OR NOT(s.`gross_sales_raw` <=> f.`gross_sales_raw`) OR NOT(s.`discount_amount_raw` <=> f.`discount_amount_raw`) OR NOT(s.`net_sales_raw` <=> f.`net_sales_raw`) OR NOT(s.`unit_acquisition_cost_raw` <=> f.`unit_acquisition_cost_raw`) OR NOT(s.`total_acquisition_cost_raw` <=> f.`total_acquisition_cost_raw`) OR NOT(s.`gross_margin_amount_raw` <=> f.`gross_margin_amount_raw`) OR NOT(s.`margin_pct_raw` <=> f.`margin_pct_raw`) OR NOT(s.`discount_rate_raw` <=> f.`discount_rate_raw`) OR NOT(s.`quantity_secondary_raw` <=> f.`quantity_secondary_raw`) OR NOT(s.`data_source_year` <=> f.`data_source_year`) OR NOT(s.`source_row_number` <=> f.`source_row_number`) OR NOT(s.`calendar_year` <=> f.`calendar_year`) OR NOT(s.`reporting_year` <=> f.`reporting_year`) OR NOT(s.`date_delivered` <=> f.`date_delivered`) OR NOT(s.`quantity` <=> f.`quantity`) OR NOT(s.`unit_selling_price` <=> f.`unit_selling_price`) OR NOT(s.`gross_sales` <=> f.`gross_sales`) OR NOT(s.`discount_amount` <=> f.`discount_amount`) OR NOT(s.`net_sales` <=> f.`net_sales`) OR NOT(s.`unit_acquisition_cost` <=> f.`unit_acquisition_cost`) OR NOT(s.`total_acquisition_cost` <=> f.`total_acquisition_cost`) OR NOT(s.`gross_margin_amount` <=> f.`gross_margin_amount`) OR NOT(s.`margin_pct` <=> f.`margin_pct`) OR NOT(s.`discount_rate` <=> f.`discount_rate`) OR NOT(s.`quantity_primary_candidate` <=> f.`quantity_primary_candidate`) OR NOT(s.`quantity_secondary_candidate` <=> f.`quantity_secondary_candidate`) OR NOT(s.`raw_fields` <=> f.`raw_fields`) OR NOT(s.`quality_rule_codes` <=> f.`quality_rule_codes`) OR NOT(s.`is_analysis_candidate` <=> f.`is_analysis_candidate`) OR NOT(s.`is_area_placeholder` <=> f.`is_area_placeholder`) OR NOT(s.`is_date_missing` <=> f.`is_date_missing`) OR NOT(s.`is_provisional_year_candidate` <=> f.`is_provisional_year_candidate`)

SELECT COUNT(*) AS records, COUNT(DISTINCT source_record_id) AS unique_records,
      COUNT_IF(is_provisional_product_demand_eligible AND (is_low_trust_2017 OR is_historical_backfill_candidate OR product_scope_status <> 'PRODUCT_MASTER_PENDING' OR quantity <= 0)) AS invalid_predecessor_provisional,
      COUNT_IF(is_approved_medical_demand_eligible AND (NOT is_medical_product_approved OR is_contract_label OR transaction_evidence='adjusted_estimated_source' OR item_kind<>'physical_product' OR canonical_sku IS NULL OR unit_of_measure IS NULL OR is_low_trust_2017 OR is_historical_backfill_candidate OR quantity <= 0)) AS invalid_approved_demand
      FROM workspace.medshield_gold.sales_restart_fact_candidate VERSION AS OF 19
